channel.title: D'Luxe Weddings & Events — Journal
channel.description: Studio notes from Madelyn Sánchez on planning a Costa Rica wedding — venue choices, ceremony rituals, vendor partnerships, and the small details that turn a well-planned day into an unforgettable one.

item.title: Wedding Planner vs. Wedding Coordinator: Which Do You Actually Need for a Costa Rica Destination Wedding?
item.dc:creator: Madelyn Sánchez
item.description: Three roles, three price points, one decision. An honest breakdown of when to hire a full-service planner, a partial planner, or a day-of coordinator for a Costa Rica destination wedding — and the critical "venue coordinator is NOT a wedding planner" clarification.

item.title: 10 Luxury Private Villa Wedding Venues in Costa Rica (2026)
item.dc:creator: Madelyn Sánchez
item.description: The Point, Castle of Oz, Vista Hermosa Estate, Casa Chameleon Las Catalinas, Villa Punto de Vista, Rancho Pacifico, Andaz Papagayo, Four Seasons Papagayo, Hacienda Pinilla, Zephyr Palace — capacity, signature ceremony spots, honest pros and cons.

item.title: Where in Costa Rica Should You Get Married? A Regional Guide
item.dc:creator: Madelyn Sánchez
item.description: Tamarindo, Papagayo, Nosara, Santa Teresa, Manuel Antonio, Uvita — six regions, six temperaments, and the kind of couple each is right for.

item.title: The Costa Rica Wedding Calendar: Best Month to Marry, By Region (2026 Guide)
item.dc:creator: Madelyn Sánchez
item.description: A region-by-region Costa Rica wedding calendar. Month-by-month weather, pricing, and demand. The planner's secret window, the bargain bet, and the week to avoid (Semana Santa).

item.title: Getting Legally Married in Costa Rica: A 2026 Guide for U.S. and Canadian Couples
item.dc:creator: Madelyn Sánchez
item.description: How U.S. and Canadian couples legally get married in Costa Rica in 2026 — required documents, the civil-marriage process, apostille, same-sex marriage (legal since 2020), and the symbolic-ceremony alternative most couples choose.

item.title: How Much Does a Luxury Wedding in Costa Rica Cost? $50K, $100K, $150K+ Breakdowns (2026)
item.dc:creator: Madelyn Sánchez
item.description: A Costa Rica luxury wedding runs $50,000–$200,000+ for 40–120 guests. INIBEP-certified planner Madelyn Sánchez breaks down every line item, by tier — F&B, floral, photography, planning, IVA tax, and how Costa Rica compares to Mexico, Hawaii, Tulum, and Italy.

item.title: Welcome to the Journal
item.dc:creator: Madelyn Sánchez
item.description: A first note from Madelyn Sánchez introducing the D'Luxe journal — studio notes on planning a Costa Rica wedding, written for couples doing their own research before reaching out.
